pasted_script_fix.what_it_does: Logs the cost of every campaign with more than 90 clicks over the last 90 days (line 7 adds 10 to the clicks and compares with 100). It reads only.

problems.problem: DURING LAST_90_DAYS is not a named range, so the query is refused
problems.fix: compute the dates in the account's time zone and use BETWEEN

problems.problem: row fields are camelCase, so r.metrics.cost_micros is undefined and cost becomes NaN
clicks arrives as a string, so clicks + 10 joins text: a campaign with 5 clicks gives "510", which is over 100, so it is logged although 5 + 10 is only 15
problems.fix: Number(r.metrics.clicks) > 90, the same threshold as clicks + 10 > 100
